title: Forward Deployment Engineer
description:

title: VP IT infrastructure operation
description:
Key responsibilities

Operations and service delivery

Lead 24×7 operations across desktop virtualisation and associated infrastructure, including Citrix, VMware, Microsoft, Wintel and networking environments, on premises and in the cloud.

Manage delivery leaders, operations managers and technical teams across L1, L2, L3 and L4; establish clear ownership, escalation paths and coordination across domains.

Build and maintain processes for business as usual operations, service transitions and operational readiness for new or expanded engagements.

Own SLA performance, service availability and capacity management; review delivery metrics and drive timely corrective actions.

Oversee NOC operations and infrastructure monitoring, ensuring alerts translate into timely action and service risks are addressed proactively.

Governance and customer management

Drive incident, problem and change management in line with ITIL practices, including major incident response, root cause analysis and prevention of recurring issues.

Ensure infrastructure compliance and operational governance, with awareness of ISO 20000 and ISO 27001 requirements.

Act as the senior escalation point for service delivery issues and manage customer expectations through clear communication and accountable resolution.

Engage senior customer stakeholders, including IT Heads and CIOs, through service reviews, performance discussions and improvement plans.

Monitor customer satisfaction and translate feedback into measurable service improvements.

Commercial and operational efficiency

Manage delivery costs, support budgets, resource utilisation and team productivity; identify opportunities to improve efficiency while sustaining service quality.

Drive cost optimisation through process improvements, innovation, automation and appropriate adoption of new technologies in ongoing operations.

Oversee annual maintenance contracts and software support arrangements, including renewals, service coverage and vendor performance.

Manage relationships with OEMs and technology partners, including Microsoft, Citrix, VMware and Nutanix, to support delivery and issue resolution.

People leadership and capability development

Define and review KRAs for delivery leaders and teams, linking individual accountability to service, customer and cost outcomes.

Coach and mentor managers and technical leaders; build management depth and succession capability.

Plan team capacity, skill development and training to meet current delivery commitments and future requirements.

Promote collaboration, disciplined execution and continuous improvement across operations.

Experience and capabilities

At least 12–14 years of relevant management experience in IT infrastructure or managed services operations, preferably with substantial desktop virtualisation exposure.

Experience leading teams of 100 or more, including managers and multiple technical domains in a 24×7 support environment.

Strong operational understanding of Citrix, VMware, Microsoft virtualisation, Wintel, networking and on premises and cloud infrastructure.

Practical experience with ITIL processes, NOC operations, monitoring tools, SLA management and customer satisfaction programmes.

Demonstrated success in delivery cost management, productivity improvement, automation, OEM engagement and software maintenance contract management.

Ability to manage senior stakeholders, resolve complex escalations and develop effective delivery leaders.

title: Network Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Network Engineer to join our team in Maharashtra. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and maintaining our network infrastructure, ensuring optimal performance and reliability. As a Network Engineer, you will play a crucial role in the design, implementation, and troubleshooting of network systems, including routers and switches. Key Responsibilities: - Design, configure, and maintain network systems to ensure high availability and performance. - Monitor network performance and troubleshoot issues as they arise. - Collaborate with other IT teams to integrate network solutions with existing systems. - Implement security measures to safeguard the network against unauthorized access and threats. - Document network configurations, changes, and procedures for future reference. - Provide support for network-related incidents and requests, ensuring timely resolution. Required Skills: - Strong knowledge of network administration and engineering principles. - Proficiency in routing and switching protocols. - Experience with L3 networking concepts and technologies. - Ability to troubleshoot network issues effectively. - Familiarity with network security practices and tools. If you are passionate about network engineering and eager to contribute to a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Ahy Consulting is a progressive development agency specializing in eCommerce growth, backed by 17 years of industry experience. The team has witnessed and adapted to the evolution of the internet, building strategies that drive measurable results for clients. Since 2018, Ahy Consulting has achieved an average 35% increase in conversions within the first six months across its eCommerce support projects. Operational processes are designed to enable sustainable growth and scale, challenging both internal teams and business owners to reach ambitious goals. More information about the company and its services is available at www.ahyconsulting.com.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Senior DevSecOps Engineer is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Kalyan Dombivli. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining secure CI/CD pipelines, integrating security controls into every stage of the software development lifecycle. The engineer will manage cloud and on\-premise infrastructure, automate deployments, monitor system performance, and ensure compliance with security best practices and standards. Daily tasks include collaborating with development and operations teams, performing vulnerability assessments, managing incident response, and improving tooling and processes for reliability, scalability, and security. The role also involves mentoring team members, documenting procedures, and contributing to architectural decisions that support eCommerce growth.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong foundation in Computer Science principles, including data structures, algorithms, and system design.
* Proficiency in Back\-End Web Development and Software Development, with experience building and maintaining APIs and microservices.
* Advanced Programming skills in one or more languages commonly used in DevSecOps environments (e.g., Python, Go, Java, or similar).
* Solid understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts and their application in secure, maintainable codebases.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) and infrastructure\-as\-code frameworks (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
* Experience implementing security practices across the SDLC, including code scanning, dependency management, and container security.
* Practical knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and Linux\-based systems administration.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams, communicate clearly, and document processes and standards.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in eCommerce or high\-traffic web applications is an advantage; relevant security certifications (e.g., CISSP, OSCP, CSSLP) are a plus.
